main_text.p: הָךְ Chald. Vide paulò ante in הוֹךְ .

הִין Hiph. הָהְיִין Paratus fuit, Paratum se obtulit, Ultrò, Promptè voluit: Futur. וַתִּהְיִנוּ לְעָלוֹ־ Et parati fuistis, Voluistis ascendere, Deut.1.41. Deducunt Hebraei ab הִן Ecce, eo sensu, quo, qui se promptum & paratum offert, dicit, הִנֵּנִי Ecce me, הִנֵּנוּ Ecce nos.
הִין Hin, Mensura liquidorum, qua continebat duodecim Logos: Logus autem sex ova, Menachoth fol.89. c.1.

הֵיכָל m. Palatium; Regia, Templum: Constr. בְּהֵיכַל הַמֶּלֶךְ In palatio regis, Dan.1.v.4. Aff. בְּהֵיכָלוֹ In templo ejus, Psal.27.4. Plur. Constr. מְהֵיכְלֵי שֵׁן E' templis eburneis, Psal.45.9. Aff. לְהֵיכְלֵיכֶם In templa vestra, Joel.3.5. Et formâ fem. הֵיכָלוֹת Templa, Hos.8.14.
הָכַר Obfirmavit se: Futur. תַּהְכְּרוּ־לִי Obfirmabitis vos mihi, aut, contra me, Job.19.3.
הַכָּרָה f. Obfirmatio, Obduratio: Constr. הַכָּרַת פְּנֵיהֶם Obfirmatio faciei ipsorum, Jef.3.9. Quidam, Agnitio faciei ipsorum, & ita est à נָכַר .

הַלְאָה Ultra, Ulterius, Loci & Temporis: נְשׁ־הַלְאָה Secede ulterius, illuc, eò, Genes.19.9. מֵהַלְאָה לְמִגְדָּל Ab ultra, id est, longè ultra turrim, Gen.35. v.21. Hinc Verbum; unde Part. ex Niph. וְהִנֶּהְלָאָה Et procul disjectam vel disjectam, Mich.4.7.

הָלַךְ Ambulavit, Ivit, Incesit: Cum אֶל construction, Adivit, Accesit: Cum מִן, Abivit, Transiit: Cum לִפְנֵי, Præcesit: Cum אַחַר, Secutus est. Præter. cum א paragogico, הָלְכוּא Qui venerant, Josh.10.24. Secunda fœm. cū ' redundante, הָלַכְתִּי Ivisti, Jer.31.21. Part.Fœm. מְרוּעַ אַתִּי הָלַכְתִּ Quare itura es, 2.Reg.4.23. cum ' utrobiq, redundante, juxta Masorethas. Infinit.

page.notes: Digitiser's watermark at foot right omitted. Uncertain readings: the second "disjectam" in the Mich.4.7 gloss may be misprinted; "Jef.3.9" is printed as such and kept; the Hebrew in the Part.Fœm. entry (מְרוּעַ אַתִּי הָלַכְתִּ) and the Hebrew headword of the Hiph. entry (הָהְיִין) are copied from the scan and should be checked against the original; the vocalisation of Hebrew words is reconstructed from the unpointed print and may differ.
